dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. I'm very grateful for your assistance earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: Our most recent inspections have confirmed that the pipes are in good condition. I don't think there's anything to worry about.

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: The assistants Mr. Estienne brought us are also very professional. They've been a great help.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I was asking about you, not the pipes.

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: Oh! I see... Thanks for your concern.

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: After that incident, I started studying some basic self-defense in my time off. So now, even if I run into trouble while I'm working, I should be able to escape at least.

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: There are some risks associated with working out here. It would be a good idea to include some fitness and self-defense skills in our staff training from now on.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've gotta take care of the Hilichurls here first!
